svg.title: C4 style container and technology boundaries for IDEA Core v0
svg.desc: An engineer uses either a browser or the IDEA Desktop. A separate Workspace process manages local engineering files and tools. Protected business commands go to the IDEA Server. The Server authorizes the operation and selects a transfer location. Large file bytes then flow directly between Workspace and an Artifact Gateway, which stores or reads immutable bytes from one of multiple Vault locations. The Gateway returns transfer evidence but cannot publish a Generation.
